facts.fact: Radio Generation reports PS Generali Nixon Korir told the Public Accounts Committee that Ardhisasa has been rolled out in Nairobi, Murang'a, Mombasa Island and Isiolo, with digitisation under way in Machakos, Kajiado and Baringo.
PS Korir said the department rolled out ArdhiPay for land-related payments and a National Stamp Duty Module to support transactions across the country.
